name: Overhaul
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on *only* PRs from new contributors for two weeks first—this cuts the risk of false negatives on core contributors while still catching edge cases early. After validating the model’s reliability, expand to all PRs only if the false negative rate stays below 5%.

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in parallel review mode on *all* PRs for two weeks—flagging issues but letting humans make the final call. This exposes false negatives (missed risks) without breaking trust, while giving us actionable data on where PR-Agent fails. The trade-off is extra human review time upfront, but we avoid silent failures that could erode code quality later. After two weeks, we’ll know if it’s safe to expand or if we need to adjust the model.

name: Ratchet
text:
DECISION: Run PR-Agent in parallel review mode on *all* PRs for one week, then decide next steps based on false negative data.

Result: We’ll know PR-Agent’s actual blind spots by measuring how often humans catch issues it misses. Owned by Sprocket.
